_comment: Prices used by src/costs.py to turn logged usage into dollars. Token prices are per million tokens. Check them against each provider's pricing page; update them here when they change, and the cost report picks them up on its next run.
_token_prices_note: Gemini is 0 because test runs use the free tier; enter paid prices if you move off it. Ollama runs on your computer, so it is always free. A model missing from this list is logged with its tokens and a blank cost, and the report warns about it.
_batch_discount_note: Message Batches API requests cost this share of the live price.
_row_prices_note: A flat cost per lead sent to Clay, and per email lookup on Apollo or Hunter. Work it out from your plan: monthly price / credits in the plan * credits one row uses in your Clay table. 0 means not set yet, and the report warns about it.
